column1: # Held-out test set for Sapu AI. Never used for training.
# Hand-labelled items the rules don't cover, from apps and folders that are
# NOT in seed.tsv, so it measures how the model generalises.
# The simulated Mac has the apps listed in ml_eval.rs installed; "orphan"
# rows belong to apps that are not installed any more.
# ── Safe: caches hidden in app data ──
# ── Review: leftovers from apps that are no longer installed ──
# ── Keep: app data, settings, personal files ──
